const suffixNumber=(...args:[...string[],number])=>console.log(args);
const sameTail:(...args:[...string[],number])=>void=suffixNumber;
const fixedTail:(text:string,n:number)=>void=suffixNumber;
sameTail('a','b',1);
fixedTail('c',2);
const allArguments=(...args:(string|number)[])=>console.log(args);
const variadicTarget:(...args:[...string[],number])=>void=allArguments;
variadicTarget('d',3);
const suffixWithPrefix=(start:boolean,...args:[...string[],number])=>console.log(start,args);
const samePrefix:(start:boolean,...args:[...string[],number])=>void=suffixWithPrefix;
samePrefix(true,'e',4);
const ignoreArguments=()=>console.log('ignored');
const ignoresTail:(...args:[...string[],number])=>void=ignoreArguments;
ignoresTail('f',5);
